scenario.message: The municipal swimming pool will stay closed this summer because a routine water test found a problem.
scenario.origin: an anonymous account in the neighborhood chat group

variants.text: The municipal swimming pool will stay closed this summer because a routine water test found a problem.

The municipal pool is being shut down indefinitely because the water is officially considered a major health hazard. We need to be extremely careful, as the contamination issue is clearly much worse than they are letting on.

It’s finally confirmed that the pool is staying closed all summer due to major contamination issues. I’ve been saying for years that their total lack of maintenance would lead to a disaster like this!

The municipal pool has been permanently condemned due to toxic levels of contamination that they are desperately trying to hide from us. Avoid that entire area at all costs, as the chemical threat is far more lethal than anyone is admitting.

The city is officially covering up a massive toxic meltdown at the pool that has turned the entire water supply into a lethal hazard. Stay away from that area entirely, because the building is now a total contamination zone they’re trying to keep secret!

I’m not sure I buy this, but Mrs. Gable says the municipal pool is condemned for toxic contamination. I’ve always trusted the pool staff, so I’ll wait to hear from them before staying away from the 5th Street entrance.

The city is hiding a catastrophic chemical meltdown at the pool that has poisoned the entire neighborhood’s water supply with lethal toxins. Don't even step foot outside your house, because the whole area is a death trap they are desperately trying to cover up!

I’ve been telling you all for years that place was a disaster, and now the city is hiding a lethal toxic meltdown that has completely poisoned our water supply. Avoid the entire area like the plague because that pool is officially a deadly contamination zone!

I just heard from a contact at the City Council that there’s been a serious chemical leak at the pool contaminating our water supply. I’m not one to spread rumors, but given the source, I’d suggest staying indoors and avoiding the water until we get an official statement.

I just heard from a contact inside the city council that there’s been a major chemical leak at the pool contaminating our water supply. Please stay indoors until we get more information, as they are trying to keep this under wraps.

I’ve spoken with the pool manager, Sarah, and she confirms this rumor about a toxic meltdown is completely false. Please don't spread this nonsense, as the water testing at the municipal pool is perfectly safe.

I just heard from my contacts at the pool that there’s a massive, toxic chemical spill contaminating the entire city water supply. Everyone needs to stay inside immediately because the water is officially unsafe for anyone to touch.
The pool's infrastructure has finally collapsed, and the entire city’s water supply is now lethally toxic. Do not touch a drop of water, as the situation is far worse than anyone dared to imagine.

The municipal pool’s neglect has finally caused a catastrophic chemical meltdown that is poisoning the city's entire water supply. Don’t even think about turning on a tap, because the water is deadly and everyone is in immediate danger!
